Backend Developer

Wise • London, United Kingdom • Full-time

Job description

Join Wise to build scalable, high-throughput financial services that make international money transfers instant, transparent, and cheap.

Responsibilities

  • Design and maintain resilient microservices in Node.js and Python
  • Write clean, well-tested code and optimize relational database queries
  • Participate in architecture reviews and on-call rotations

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of backend development experience with Node.js or Python
  • Solid understanding of SQL databases, transactions, and indexing
  • Experience building and documenting RESTful APIs

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in fintech, banking, or high-load distributed systems
  • Knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes
